methods.text_en: Present the established pose through low angles and clear contours without inventing heroic identity.
methods.text_zh: 以低角度和清楚轮廓呈现已有姿态，不增加英雄身份。

methods.text_en: Keep important phases of existing action readable without changing speed or duration.
methods.text_zh: 既有动作的重要阶段保持可读；不擅改速度或延长时长。
